Class GraduateStudent

java.lang.Object
project.models.actors.User
project.models.actors.Student
project.models.actors.GraduateStudent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, JournalObserver
public class GraduateStudent extends Student
A master's or PhD student. Extends Student with a research supervisor and diploma projects. When created, the system automatically wraps this object in a ResearcherDecorator.

    • setResearchSupervisor

      public void setResearchSupervisor(ResearcherDecorator supervisor) throws InvalidSupervisorException
      Assigns a research supervisor. The supervisor must be a researcher with an h-index ≥ 3.
      Parameters:
      supervisor - the proposed supervisor (must be non-null and qualified)
      Throws:
      InvalidSupervisorException - if the supervisor is null or has insufficient h-index

    • addDiplomaProject

      public void addDiplomaProject(ResearchPaper paper)
      Adds a diploma/thesis paper. Also propagates the paper to this student's ResearcherDecorator in the database so it shows up in research listings.
      Parameters:
      paper - the paper to attach to this student's profile
